ex.card.desc.ctc.ser-o-estar-adjetivos-2: Decide between ser and estar with adjectives by matching sentences to their logical endings.

ex.card.desc.dnd.ser-vs-estar-categorias: Sort common categories into those typically used with ser (essences) or estar (situations).
ex.card.desc.dnd.ser-vs-estar-common-cat: Sort common categories into those typically used with ser (essences) or estar (situations).
ex.card.desc.fitb.otros-equivalentes-de-: Practice common alternatives to ser and estar—like haber, hacer, and tener—in everyday expressions.
ex.card.desc.fitb.ser-o-estar-llenar-los: Complete each sentence with ser or estar, choosing based on identity, traits, emotions, actions, or physical position.
ex.card.desc.fitb.ser-o-estar-participio: Practice using estar + past participle to express resulting states, paying attention to agreement in gender and number.
ex.card.desc.fitb.ser-y-estar-entidad-ma: Choose the correct form of ser or estar based on whether you’re locating a physical entity or an event.
